title: RAND, RANDARRAY, and RANDBETWEEN set PtgAttrSemi syntactically, and RANDARRAY requires _xlfn.
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, RAND(), RANDARRAY([rows], [columns], [min], [max], [whole_number]), and RANDBETWEEN(bottom, top) all mark the enclosing formula syntactically volatile (PtgAttrSemi) regardless of whether the call is in a taken branch, and refuse reference-place or call-postfix uses at entry. RANDARRAY requires the _xlfn. prefix in OOXML (bare @RANDARRAY gives #NAME?), whereas RAND and RANDBETWEEN need no prefix; degenerate bounds RANDBETWEEN(1,1) and RANDARRAY(1,1,1,1,TRUE) deterministically return 1.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 191-193), excel-entry.tsv (14 entry checks), and volatility probes in VOLATILITY.md.
